Hi,

I'm new to MS stats and am trying to run a pilot comparison from skyline to see how it works. I'm running MS-stats version 2.1.5 and Skyline 2.5.0.5675. When I run the group comparison with my data (only one replicate, many conditions) or with the skyline sample dataset I get the error in the attached document and copied below.

Is this something you have come across before?

Thanks,
Rich


Error in groupComparison(contrast.matrix = comparison, data = quantData,  :

Dear Richard,

First, I am sorry for late response. We found similar error message from some of users. 
Now, We fixed this bug in MSstats external tool(v2.1.6) of Skyline. You can update the newest version from Tool Store in Skyline. 

Thank you again for reporting this bug and please let us know if you still have the issue.

Meena
